# Revise

> Revise is a free, local-first revision app for WJEC A-level, Physics first, that picks the one most useful thing to study next. Four WJEC subjects are authored to their specification but no question has been human-reviewed yet, so it does not claim to prove improvement.

Four WJEC A-level subjects (Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry and Physics) have their topics and specification statements authored. No question has been through human review yet, so Revise cannot yet prove that a learner has improved. Other boards and qualifications reuse those outlines and are labelled reference material. This is the static landing page; the app itself, and the markdown versions of its lessons, library and guides, live at https://revise-gray.vercel.app.

## Core pages
- [Landing page](https://revise-site-henrygoldsmith07-9188s-projects.vercel.app/index.md): Revise — WJEC A-level revision that tells you the one thing to do next. Four subjects authored to their specification, FSRS scheduling, examiner-style marking, and honest coverage: nothing counts as evidence until two people have reviewed it.

## The app
- [Revise](https://revise-gray.vercel.app/index.md): Revise is a free, local-first revision app for WJEC A-level, Physics first, that picks the one most useful thing to study next. Four WJEC subjects are authored to their specification but no question has been human-reviewed yet, so it does not claim to prove improvement.
